 Tennis Picks
 A surging form and an undeniable baseline dominance have established Ann Li as an attractive pick at +140 to sweep Ashlyn Krueger in their semifinal match in Osaka.
 Current Form:
 Ann Li fended off a serious challenge from Lilli Tagger, beating the Austrian rising star in three sets, 6-4, 3-6, 7-6, in the quarterfinals of the 2026 Japan Open – Osaka. Li, who is 6-1 in her last 7 matches, scored a bagel against Tagger in the third-set tiebreak.
 Ashlyn Krueger overpowered Talia Gibson 6-1, 6-3 to reach the semifinals. Krueger conceded only one service break, winning 78 percent of first-serve points and firing 6 aces. She also broke the Australian 5 times behind 34 return points. Krueger is 6-2 in her last 8 matches.
 The Matchup: Li is 2-0 vs. Krueger in their head-to-head series, sweeping her fellow American netter on both occasions.

 Our Ann Li vs Ashlyn Krueger Prediction

 What to Expect: Li dictates the points again, sweeping Krueger for the second time in weeks. Li’s ability to control the baseline exchanges will play a big role in this matchup against Krueger, who has broken Li only twice in their past two matches.
